items.html: And the lights, too, gain further correction, for at first these Nekudot were without lines and without the phase of a Partzuf; indeed each one was included of ten, in the secret of a general mixture blended within them, and the lights did not show their action. But now, through this bond, formed by means of this Ibur [impregnation], the lights showed their action: this one the phase of the Rosh, and that one the phase of the Guf, and there was an eye that sees and an ear that hears, etc.
